user.title: School day
user.description: Enter a name (e.g. "School Mateo") and, optionally, the URL of the calendar CSV (a local path such as /config/lectivo/mateo.csv also works). With no CSV, or if it does not exist or is empty, every Monday-Friday is a school day.
